To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the main challenges when handling big-data are data management and analytics; (2) the key solutions are data management and data analytics; (3) the main cross-disciplinary research areas are big-data management and big-data analytics; (4) the key cross-disciplinary research challenges are data management and information analytics.
the challenges and solutions to big data are multidimensional, interdisciplinary and dynamic.

big data is not only about the size of the data but also about the variety, velocity, and veracity of data; big data is not just about the technology but also about the people who handle the data and the process that involves the technology and people; big data is a multidisciplinary research area, and it is important to have an interdisciplinary approach to solve big data challenges.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of novel techniques to handle big data and its applications.
the design and development of novel methods and techniques for handling big data.
the challenges that arise in big data handling, which include data acquisition, data management, data analysis, data mining, data visualization and data dissemination.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
big data is a very broad term that encompasses many aspects, and therefore the challenges and future directions are also broad and diverse.
big data research is a new and exciting area of computer science that has attracted a lot of interest from the research and industrial community.
the challenges of big data are far from over.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
handling big data is a challenging task, but it is also an exciting research area with great opportunities.

the big data challenges can be addressed through a combination of (a) the development of new data management and analysis tools and techniques, (b) the use of existing data management and analysis technologies, (c) the integration of data and information from multiple sources, and (d) the development of cross-disciplinary approaches.
we need a better understanding of big data and how to handle it.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is a need to establish a new paradigm for big data handling that is based on the integration of data management, data mining, machine learning, and data analytics.
the research community needs to work together to tackle the big data challenge in order to extract valuable knowledge and insights from big data.
the big data research field is a multidisciplinary one, and that the challenges identified are not only technological, but also involve the social and ethical aspects of big data.
